verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents its own ways to get data out. The App API can fetch data, data-out integrations send data to external platforms, and the CLI returns structured JSON across the Journeys and Pipelines APIs, so data can leave in an open format. None of these is documented as a complete export of everything in the workspace, so the 'all of my data and leave' part is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk export feature, explicit coverage of all data types (profiles, events, messages, templates, automations), stated export formats such as CSV/JSON dumps, and independent or hands-on evidence of a successful complete migration out.
